title: Synthetic WMS problem tickets for inquiry workflow

tickets.title: Scan retry may apply an operation twice
tickets.report: A scan request times out. After the worker retries, it is unclear whether the first request changed inventory, so the operation may be applied twice.

tickets.title: Similar screen definitions have unclear differences
tickets.report: Two screen definitions look similar. It is unknown whether one is obsolete or whether they represent different warehouse cases.

tickets.title: Screen fails before it appears
tickets.report: Opening screen S-127 produces an error. Its intended purpose and expected content are unknown.

tickets.title: Screen fields render but their meaning is unclear
tickets.report: The replacement screen renders, but the meaning and requiredness of several fields are unknown.

tickets.title: Validation error has an unknown cause
tickets.report: Entering a value produces a validation error. It is unclear whether the value violates a warehouse rule or the screen is misconfigured.

tickets.title: Screen has no agreed success condition
tickets.report: The screen can be made to render, but the outcome that would make it correct is unknown.

tickets.title: Screen has no known place in the workflow
tickets.report: A screen definition exists, but what leads to it, what it depends on, and what should happen afterward are unknown.

tickets.title: Interrupted replenishment is difficult to resume
tickets.report: After a device change or shift handoff, the next worker cannot tell whether replenishment was started, partly completed, or not recorded.
